news.headline: MAK Capital discloses growing 7.8% passive stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund LP, MAK Capital One and Michael A. Kaufman jointly reported beneficial ownership of 2,375,861 CLPT shares (7.8%) as of June 30, 2026, up from a 6.1-6.3% position disclosed earlier in the year, filed as a passive (non-activist) 13G/A.

news.headline: Stifel cuts ClearPoint Neuro price target to $22 from $25 after Q2 miss
news.summary: Following the Q2 revenue miss and guidance reset, Stifel trimmed its CLPT price target to $22 while keeping a Buy rating, citing the company's long-term neuro-navigation and gene-therapy delivery platform value despite near-term execution bumps.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 results, unveils $500M five-pillar strategy, cuts FY2026 guidance
news.source: ClearPoint Neuro press release / AccessNewswire / BioSpace / StockTitan
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $10.9M (+18% YoY) but roughly $1.8M below the ~$12.7M consensus, sending shares down about 15-20% after hours to the $13-14 range; management reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $48-52M and laid out a five-pillar, $500M long-term revenue strategy built around cell/gene-therapy delivery, the newly possessed CAL preclinical facility, a 10-year SONOCARE focused-ultrasound partnership, and in-development robotics/Harmony 1.0 software.

news.headline: Partner Aspen Neuroscience receives FDA RMAT designation for Parkinson's cell therapy delivered via ClearPoint platform
news.source: ClearPoint Neuro press release / AccessNewswire / BioSpace
news.summary: Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using the ClearPoint Navigation System and SmartFlow cannula in the ASPIRO trial, received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation, giving the program expedited-development and potential accelerated-approval pathways.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to file a BLA for AMT-130, a gene therapy delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, after the FDA agreed 3-year Phase I/II data can support accelerated approval; would be a major validation of ClearPoint's delivery platform if it proceeds on schedule.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical trial data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided to roughly 10 partner data/regulatory readouts on an almost-monthly cadence as 10-15 partner-run clinical trials using ClearPoint technology begin or continue enrolling patients.

catalysts.label: First GLP services revenue from CAL facility
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's newly acquired 30,000 sq ft Advanced Laboratories (CAL) facility in Torrey Pines has signed its first GLP statement of work, expected to complete in H1 2027, an early proof point toward the long-term $60M+ preclinical-services capacity target.

catalysts.label: Potential first commercial cell/gene-therapy launches on ClearPoint platform
catalysts.detail: Management believes recent positive FDA feedback to multiple biopharma partners could let additional cell and gene therapies reach commercial launch using ClearPoint delivery technology by end of 2027, which would drive recurring per-procedure/disposable revenue.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report should show progress against the reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $48-52M and early traction on the CAL, robotics, and SONOCARE focused-ultrasound growth pillars.

catalysts.label: Robotic platform & Harmony 1.0 software commercial launch
catalysts.detail: The in-development robotic surgical platform and Harmony 1.0 navigation software were showcased at multiple neurosurgery trade shows in Q2 2026 with positive surgeon feedback, but a formal commercial launch date has not yet been set.

pulse: CLPT trades around $14, still digesting the Aug 3 Q2 miss (revenue $10.9M vs ~$12.7M consensus) that knocked shares down 15-20%, even as management reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $48-52M and unveiled a five-pillar, $500M long-term strategy spanning cell/gene-therapy delivery, the new CAL preclinical facility, focused ultrasound, and robotics/software. Stifel trimmed its target to $22 (still Buy) on Aug 4, and MAK Capital's Aug 12 13G/A showed its passive stake growing to 7.8%, signaling institutional accumulation despite the selloff. The forward story remains partner-driven, centered on uniQure's expected Q3 2026 AMT-130 BLA filing and roughly 10 partner data readouts management expects over the next 12-18 months.
